stories.title: DWP publishes Independent Disability Advisory Panel remit
stories.summary: Newly published terms of reference set out how expertise from Deaf and disabled people and people with long-term health conditions will inform DWP policy design and delivery. This is a governance publication, not a benefits-rate change or a funding award.

stories.title: Severe drought triggers stronger water-supply protection measures
stories.summary: Severe drought has been declared in parts of six southern English counties, with daily reservoir and river monitoring, tighter abstraction checks and local resilience planning. Defra says customer supplies remain uninterrupted; the action is preventative rather than an announcement of supply cuts.

stories.title: Defra seeks evidence on proposed persistent organic pollutants
stories.summary: Defra is requesting scientific and socioeconomic evidence to support Stockholm Convention assessments of nominated flame retardants and related pollutants. This is an evidence-gathering step towards possible international controls, not a newly enacted ban.

stories.title: Unknown First World War soldier buried with full military honours
stories.summary: BBC reports that an unidentified soldier believed to have served with the West Yorkshire Regiment was buried in France on 14 October, in a service organised by the MoD’s Joint Casualty and Compassionate Centre. The report is newly published in this window; the ceremony occurred the preceding day.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: BIST releases first National Survey of Businesses
stories.summary: The first results cover interviews with 1,019 senior representatives of UK businesses with employees, conducted from June to August 2026. The new survey broadens coverage beyond international trade to domestic business policy; these are newly published statistics, not newly occurring business events.

stories.title: Franco-German proposal opens conditional route into “Made in Europe” rules
stories.summary: The Guardian reports that France now backs conditional UK inclusion in proposed EU automotive preference rules, tied to reciprocity and alignment on trade-defence measures. This remains a proposal in draft legislation, not an agreed UK exemption or a concluded trade deal.
